title.en: Before renting

what: Everything the owner decides and prepares before the first viewing: worth, price, readiness, insurance, management, house rules.

title.en: Is renting worth it

what: Put the home's rent against selling it or living in it, in words and with the owner's own inputs.

title.he: רשמו מה הדירה שווה היום לדעתכם
title.en: Write down what you think the home is worth today

what: Record one value for the home, with the source you took it from (your own estimate, an appraiser, a comparable sale you looked up yourself).
proof: a dated line with the value and its source
money: No figure is supplied by the product; the owner types his own.
if_skipped: Every later comparison (yield, sell or rent) has no base.

title.he: רשמו כל הוצאה קבועה שנשארת עליכם
title.en: List every running cost that stays with you

what: Write the costs the law leaves with the landlord: building insurance, fixing defects that are not the tenant's fault, a broker's fee if the broker worked for you.
proof: a costs sheet with one line per cost
money: The landlord pays these; the amounts are the owner's own quotes.

law.quote: דמי ביטוח בעד ביטוח הדירה המושכרת בביטוח מבנה
המשכיר יתקן על חשבונו כל ליקוי או פגם אחר

if_skipped: The yield looks higher than it is.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): expenses are recorded in the ledger (kinds expense/income); no 'before renting' costs sheet

title.en: Work out gross yield in words

what: Yearly rent you expect divided by the home's value from the first leaf, shown as a sentence the owner can read. Inputs: monthly rent, months you expect it to be rented, value.
proof: the sentence with the three inputs
money: No market figure is built in; only the owner's inputs.
if_skipped: The owner compares options by feeling.

product_today.where: assets/rentals/earn/earn.js (not released): an earnings estimate; inputs and wording not yet matched to this leaf

title.en: Plan months with no tenant

what: Decide how many empty months a year you allow in the calculation, so the yield is not computed on twelve full months.
proof: the number of empty months in the sheet
money: An empty month is rent you do not receive; costs continue.
if_skipped: The yield is overstated.

title.en: Work out net yield after tax

what: Take the gross figure, subtract the costs and the tax track chosen with the accountant. The tax track is branch 07; here only ask the accountant before the first contract.
proof: the accountant's written answer on the tax track
money: Tax is paid by the landlord; the rate is the accountant's answer, not a figure the product supplies.
if_skipped: A surprise at the yearly tax report.

title.en: Compare with the money from selling

what: Write what you would have if you sold: the value minus the sale costs and tax (asked from an accountant or lawyer), and what you would do with the money. Compare in one sentence with the rent option.
proof: a dated comparison note
money: Sale costs and tax: the professional's own figures.
if_skipped: The decision to rent is made without the alternative in sight.

title.he: השוו לגור בה בעצמכם או במשפחה
title.en: Compare with living in it yourself or lending it to family

what: Write what you or a relative would save or lose by living in the home instead of renting it out. A relative who rents is a rental in law; a free loan is a different contract (שאילה).
proof: a dated note

law.quote: שאילה היא זכות להחזיק בנכס ולהשתמש בו שלא לצמיתות, כשהזכות הוקנתה שלא בתמורה

if_skipped: A family arrangement starts without an agreed form.

title.he: בדקו אם שכר הדירה מעל תקרת סימן ו
title.en: Check if the rent is above the ceiling of the residential-lease chapter

what: The protections for a residential lease do not apply when the monthly rent is above a sum the law sets and updates each 1 January. Compare your planned rent with the current published sum.
proof: the current sum and its source written next to the rent
money: The text names 20,000 NIS as the base sum, updated each 1 January by the CPI; the Minister publishes the updated sum, which the owner must read.

law.quote: דמי השכירות לפיו, לחודש, עולים על 20,000 שקלים חדשים או על סכום אחר שקבע שר המשפטים

if_skipped: The owner assumes the chapter's rules apply (or do not apply) without checking.

title.en: Decide the planned length of the lease

what: Record the planned term. A lease of up to three months with no option to extend, and one over ten years that the landlord cannot end earlier, are outside the residential chapter.
proof: the planned term in the file

law.quote: תקופת השכירות לפיו אינה עולה על שלושה חודשים
תקופת השכירות לפיו עולה על עשר שנים

if_skipped: The wrong rules are assumed for the contract.

title.en: Note if the tenant is a relative

what: A lease to a relative keeps most of the chapter but one section (the ban on contracting out) does not apply between relatives. Record who the relative is.
proof: a line in the file naming the relationship

law.quote: בין משכיר ובין שוכר שהוא קרוב שלו

title.en: Setting the price

what: Find the public sources for asking and actual rents, collect comparables by hand, and fix an asking price and a floor.

title.he: פתחו את טבלת שכר הדירה הממוצע של הלמ"ס
title.en: Open the CBS average-rent table

what: Open Table 4.9 of the Central Bureau of Statistics Price Statistics Monthly (copy in docs/research/2026-11-19-rent-earn/cbs/) and read the row for your district and number of rooms. Read the table's own definition before comparing it to a new lease.
proof: the district, rooms and quarter written beside the price
money: A CBS average is a statistic, not a promise; the product shows the CBS figure as published with its sampling error.
if_skipped: The price is set from memory or from a friend.

product_today.where: assets/rentals/earn/cbs-rent-2026q3.json and earn.js exist but are not loaded anywhere (inc/rentals-earn.php is not in the module list)

title.en: Collect three similar ads nearby

what: Find at least three live ads for a home like yours in the same area, by hand, and write down the asking rent of each, the rooms, the floor and the link.
proof: three links with the asking figure of each
money: An asking rent is what the owner of the other home asks, not what was signed.
if_skipped: The price has no local anchor.

title.he: בדקו אם מודעות דומות נעלמות מהר או נשארות
title.en: See whether similar ads disappear fast or stay

what: Look at the same three ads again after a week and write down which stayed and which went. This tells you if the asking figures are met.
when: a week after collecting the ads
proof: a note per ad: still up or gone, with the date
if_skipped: An asking figure is taken as a market figure.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist or template for this step

title.he: הבינו מאיפה מגיעים נתוני שכירות פומביים
title.en: Know where public rent data comes from

what: Write on the file which sources are public and primary (the CBS table) and which are only asking ads on listing sites. Whether the Tax Authority publishes rental contract data was not verified; do not claim it.
proof: a source list in the file
if_skipped: Ads are mistaken for signed rents.

title.en: Set an asking price and a floor

what: Decide the figure you will publish and the lowest figure you accept, in writing, before the first call.
proof: two figures in the file with the date
money: The monthly rent is agreed between the parties; no figure is supplied by the product.
if_skipped: Negotiation happens with no limit decided.

title.he: קבעו מה כלול ומה משלם השוכר מעבר לשכר
title.en: Decide what is on top of the rent and who pays it

what: List the extra payments: the law puts the tenant in charge of tax on the holder (arnona), utilities, and house-committee maintenance for the tenancy period. Decide how they are shown in the ad and the contract.
proof: a list of extra payments, each with who pays
money: The tenant pays the items listed in section 25ט(א) for the tenancy period; the landlord pays building insurance.

law.quote: השוכר יישא בתשלומים אלה לגבי תקופת השכירות
תשלומים נוספים החלים על השוכר שאינם דמי שכירות, אם ישנם, וגובהם

if_skipped: A disagreement on who pays arnona, water or the house committee.

title.he: החליטו אם מצמידים את שכר הדירה למדד
title.en: Decide whether to link the rent to the CPI

what: Decide yes or no now so the ad and the contract say the same. The mechanics are branch 05.
proof: the decision written in the file
if_skipped: The ad and the contract disagree.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): money.php supports CPI linkage up and down

title.en: The home is ready to rent

what: The legal minimum of a home fit to live in, the safety checks, cleaning and painting, the appliances that stay, the instructions for the tenant.

title.en: The legal minimum: a home fit to live in

what: The first schedule lists six conditions; if any one holds, the home is not fit to live in. Handing over such a home is a breach of the contract and this cannot be contracted out of.

title.en: Check there is drainage and waste removal

what: Run water in every sink, shower and toilet and look that it drains and that the waste leaves properly.
proof: a dated tick and a photo of the working drain

law.quote: היא אינה כוללת מערכת ניקוז, לרבות מערכת לסילוק סדיר של שפכים ודלוחין

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in; handing it over is a breach of the contract.

title.en: Check there is electricity and lighting

what: Test the electrical system and the lighting in every room; a licensed electrician checks the installation in the safety branch.
proof: a dated tick

law.quote: היא אינה כוללת מערכת חשמל או מערכת תאורה

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in.

title.he: ודאו פתחי אוורור, אור טבעי, דלתות וחלונות, ונעילה בכניסה
title.en: Check ventilation, natural light, doors and windows, and a lock on the entrance door

what: Open every window and door, check each closes and that the main entrance door locks.
proof: a dated tick and a photo of the entrance lock

law.quote: דלת כניסה ראשית בעלת אמצעי נעילה

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in.

title.en: Check there is a supply of drinking water

what: Open the taps and check that water runs on the cold and hot lines.
proof: a dated tick

law.quote: היא אינה כוללת מערכת להספקת מי שתייה

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in.

title.he: ודאו שיש מחיצה בין השירותים לדירה
title.en: Check there is a partition between the toilet and the home

what: Confirm the toilet is closed off from the rest of the home.
proof: a dated tick

law.quote: היא אינה כוללת מחיצה בין השירותים ובין הדירה

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in.

title.he: ודאו שאין סיכון בלתי סביר לבטיחות או לבריאות
title.en: Check there is no unreasonable risk to safety or health

what: Walk the home with a safety list (the checks below) and write down anything that is an unreasonable risk to the tenant's safety or health; fix it before handing over.
proof: a dated tick and the repair invoices, if any

law.quote: יש בה סיכון בלתי־סביר לבטיחות השוכר או לבריאותו

if_skipped: The home does not count as fit to live in. What counts as unreasonable is not defined in the schedule.

title.he: אל תתנו לחוזה לוותר על דירה ראויה
title.en: Do not let the contract waive a fit home

what: A contract term cannot waive the fit-home rule, even if the tenant agrees. Check that no clause in your draft tries to.
proof: the clause list marked clean

law.quote: אין להתנות על הוראות סעיף 25ו

if_skipped: The clause is void and the home may still count as not fit.

title.en: What exactly is handed over

what: The description of the home, the fittings and the defects the owner knows of, written before signing.

title.en: List the furniture and fittings that stay

what: Write the fittings in the home, including the shared parts that go with it, since the contract must describe them.
proof: a room-by-room list, signed with the contract

law.quote: תיאור הדירה המושכרת, הריהוט והאבזרים שבה

if_skipped: A dispute on what was in the home.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances table with add, edit, remove (rm-drawers.js); no full furniture list

title.en: Write down every defect you know of

what: The contract must name any defect that is not minor and any disturbance in or near the home that you know of. Write them all now.
proof: a list of known defects signed with the contract

law.quote: הידוע למשכיר בעת כריתת החוזה

if_skipped: A clause that frees the landlord from a defect he knew and did not mention is void.

title.en: Do not hide a defect you know of

what: A clause freeing the landlord from responsibility for a mismatch or defect is void if he knew or should have known and did not say so. Tell the tenant before signing.
proof: a dated message to the tenant listing the defects

law.quote: בטלה, אם המשכיר ידע או היה עליו לדעת על אי־ההתאמה או הפגם

if_skipped: The waiver clause is void and the tenant can rely on the defect.

title.he: פנו את הדירה ממה שלא נשאר
title.en: Clear out what does not stay

what: At handover the home must be empty of every person and of every thing except what was agreed to stay. Remove your own belongings that are not in the list.
proof: photos of each empty room

law.quote: פנויה מכל אדם או נכס, למעט נכס שהוסכם כי יהיה בדירה בעת מסירתה

if_skipped: The home is not handed over as the law describes.

title.en: Safety checks

what: The owner asks licensed professionals to check the systems that can hurt the tenant. The product only records that each check happened.

title.en: Book a licensed electrician's check

what: Ask an electrician to check the installation: panel, earth, sockets, wires. Keep his written confirmation.
proof: the electrician's written note or invoice
money: The landlord pays; the price is the electrician's own quote.

law.quote: יש בה סיכון בלתי־סביר לבטיחות השוכר או לבריאותו

if_skipped: A hidden electrical fault may count as an unreasonable safety risk.

title.he: הזמינו בדיקת גז אצל בעל מקצוע מוסמך
title.en: Book a gas check with a licensed professional

what: If the home has a gas line or a gas appliance, ask a licensed gas fitter to check it and keep his note. I did not read a primary text that fixes a periodic gas check for a rented home, so nothing is claimed about a deadline.
proof: the fitter's written note

law.quote: יש בה סיכון בלתי־סביר לבטיחות השוכר או לבריאותו

if_skipped: A gas fault may count as an unreasonable safety risk.

title.en: Check the water heater, the AC and the pipes

what: Ask a plumber or technician to check that the water heater, the AC and the pipes work and do not leak.
proof: a note or photo per system
money: The landlord pays for putting right a defect that is not the tenant's fault.

law.quote: המשכיר יתקן על חשבונו כל ליקוי או פגם אחר

if_skipped: A defect found later is yours to fix within the legal time.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances and repairs are recorded; no pre-rental check list

title.en: Check locks, railings and windows

what: Check every lock opens and closes, the balcony and stair railings are firm, and the windows close.
proof: a dated tick and photos of any repair

law.quote: יש בה סיכון בלתי־סביר לבטיחות השוכר או לבריאותו

if_skipped: A loose railing is a safety risk to the tenant.

title.en: Check for damp and mould

what: Look at walls, ceilings and under sinks for damp or mould and fix the source before painting.
proof: photos before and after the repair

law.quote: יש בה סיכון בלתי־סביר לבטיחות השוכר או לבריאותו

if_skipped: Damp may count as a health risk; painting over it hides it.

title.en: Cleaning, painting and small repairs

what: Bring the home to a clean, painted state and record how it looked.

title.en: Clean the home

what: Clean every room, the windows and the appliances before photographing.
proof: a receipt or a dated tick
money: The landlord pays, in his own arrangement.
if_skipped: The first impression and the baseline photos are weaker.

title.en: Paint or patch the walls

what: Paint where needed, after the damp check; keep the paint colour and brand for later touch-ups.
proof: the invoice with the paint name and colour code
if_skipped: The exit comparison has no clean starting point.

title.en: Photograph every room before move-in

what: Take dated photos of every room, every fixture and every appliance, with a close-up of any existing mark.
proof: the photo set with date and time
if_skipped: A later dispute on damage has no baseline.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): photos can be attached to a repair; no pre-rental photo set

title.en: Appliances that stay

what: Decide, test and list every appliance left in the home.

title.en: Decide which appliance stays

what: Choose appliance by appliance what stays (oven, fridge, washer, AC, water heater) and what you take.
proof: the list in the file
if_skipped: The tenant assumes something stays that you meant to take.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances add, edit, remove

title.he: בדקו שכל מכשיר עובד וצלמו תווית
title.en: Test each appliance and photograph its label

what: Switch each on, check it works, photograph the model and serial label.
proof: a photo of the label and a dated tick per appliance
if_skipped: A breakdown early in the lease has no record of a working start.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances kept with a name; no check step and no label photo field

title.he: רשמו אחריות וחשבונית של כל מכשיר
title.en: Keep the warranty and invoice of each appliance

what: Store the invoice and warranty end date so a repair during the lease can be claimed.
when: when buying or listing the appliance
proof: a scanned invoice
if_skipped: A repair that was under warranty is paid by you.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): documents table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a file; no dedicated screen for this step

title.he: רשמו בחוזה מי מתקן מכשיר שמקולקל
title.en: Write who repairs a broken appliance

what: Fix in writing that a tenant-caused fault is the tenant's to repair unless the parties agreed otherwise, and any other fault not minor is yours within the legal time.
proof: the clause in the signed contract

law.quote: השוכר אחראי על כל ליקוי בדירה המושכרת, לרבות פגם, שנגרם עקב שימוש בלתי סביר

if_skipped: Each side blames the other at the first breakdown.

title.en: Prepare maintenance and usage instructions for the tenant

what: Write short instructions for the water heater, the AC, the alarm, the gas shut-off and the fuse board, and give them to the tenant at the latest at handover.
proof: the instructions with the date handed over

law.quote: הוראות תחזוקה ושימוש בקשר לדירה, למיתקניה ולנכסים שבה

if_skipped: The duty to give instructions is not met.

product_today.where: assets/rentals/help (v2, admin only) has tenant help; no landlord instruction sheet

title.en: Replace or copy the keys

what: Make enough copies for the tenant and keep a set. Decide if you replace the lock cylinder.
proof: a count of the keys in the file
money: The landlord pays, at the locksmith's price.
if_skipped: The tenant has a single key or an old one in unknown hands.

title.en: Insurance

what: The product types the owner asks his insurer about. No prices.

title.en: Check you have building insurance

what: Check the home has building insurance. The tenant cannot be charged for it.
proof: the policy and its end date
money: The landlord pays building insurance; the tenant does not bear it.

law.quote: דמי ביטוח בעד ביטוח הדירה המושכרת בביטוח מבנה

if_skipped: The home is uninsured against structural damage.

title.he: שאלו את המבטח אם הפוליסה ממשיכה כשהדירה מושכרת
title.en: Ask the insurer if the policy continues while the home is rented

what: Tell the insurer that the home is let and ask in writing whether cover continues and on what terms.
proof: the insurer's written reply
if_skipped: A claim may be refused for a change nobody reported. Terms differ by policy; ask.

title.he: שאלו על ביטוח אחריות כלפי צד שלישי
title.en: Ask about third-party liability cover

what: A product type that covers a claim from a person injured in or because of the home. Ask whether your policy has it.
proof: the policy page that names the cover or the insurer's reply
if_skipped: Unknown: it depends on the policy.

title.he: שאלו על ביטוח תכולה למה שאתם משאירים
title.en: Ask about contents cover for what you leave

what: A product type for the furniture and appliances you own that stay in the home. Ask whether your policy has it.
proof: the policy page or the insurer's reply
if_skipped: Appliances you leave are not covered if the policy does not include them.

title.he: שאלו על כיסוי לאובדן דמי שכירות
title.en: Ask about rent-loss cover

what: A product type that pays when rent stops for a reason the policy names. Ask whether the insurer offers it and its conditions; do not assume it exists.
proof: the insurer's reply
if_skipped: Unknown: the product may not be offered.

title.he: שמרו את כל הפוליסות בתיק הדירה
title.en: Keep every policy in the home's file

what: Scan each policy with its end date and set a reminder for renewal.
proof: the scanned policy and a reminder date
if_skipped: A policy lapses unnoticed.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist or template for this step

title.he: לנהל לבד או עם חברת ניהול
title.en: Manage alone or with a management company

what: Decide who does the work of renting and who holds the tenant's data.

title.he: רשמו מה תעשו בעצמכם ומה אין לכם זמן
title.en: List what you will do yourself and what you will not have time for

what: Write the recurring jobs (collecting rent, calls about faults, yearly checks) next to how long each takes you.
proof: a job list with your own time estimate
if_skipped: The decision is made without the workload in sight.

title.en: Ask a management company for a written offer

what: Ask for the services included, what costs extra, the length of the agreement and how to end it, in writing.
proof: the written offer
money: The company's fee is set in its offer; the product supplies no figure.
if_skipped: Hidden extras.

title.he: אם החברה גם מתווכת, דרשו רישיון ותיווך בכתב
title.en: If the company also brokers, ask for its licence and a written order

what: Finding a tenant for a fee is brokering and needs a licence; ask to see the licence and sign a written order before any fee.
proof: the licence number and the signed order

law.quote: לא יעסוק אדם בתיווך במקרקעין, אלא אם כן הוא בעל רשיון בתוקף
מתווך במקרקעין לא יהא זכאי לדמי תיווך, אלא אם כן חתם הלקוח על הזמנה בכתב

if_skipped: The fee may not be due; an unlicensed broker may not practice.

title.he: ודאו שהחברה שומרת את פרטי השוכרים בבטחה
title.en: Check the company keeps the tenants' details secure

what: A company holding your tenants' details for you shares the duty to secure them. Ask in writing how it stores and protects them.
proof: the company's written answer

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: בעל שליטה במאגר מידע ומחזיק במאגר מידע, כל אחד מהם אחראי לאבטחת המידע

if_skipped: A leak of tenants' details is partly your responsibility. Whether a small owner's records count as a data base in law is a legal question.

title.en: Decide: alone or with a company

what: Record the decision and the date to review it (after the first year).
proof: the decision and a review date

title.he: כללי הבית: חיות, עישון, שכירות משנה
title.en: House rules: pets, smoking, subletting

what: Decide what the tenant may do, then write it in the contract so no one argues later.

title.en: Decide if a pet is allowed

what: Choose yes, no or yes with conditions (kind, number, a deposit for damage within the lawful security limit). I found no primary rule that fixes this for a rented home, so it is a matter of the contract.
proof: the rule in the ad and the contract
if_skipped: Disputes later; the tenant may rely on silence.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): the applicant form has a 'I have a pet' field (he.json p_pets); no landlord rule setting

title.en: Decide if smoking is allowed

what: Choose and write the rule. The public-places smoking law I read names the places where smoking is banned and does not set a rule for the inside of a rented apartment.
proof: the rule in the ad and the contract

title.en: Decide if subletting is allowed

what: By default the tenant may not pass the home on or sublet without the landlord's consent, given in advance and in writing. If you allow it, write the consent in the contract.
proof: the clause in the contract

law.quote: אלא בהסכמת המשכיר
תיעשה מראש ובכתב

if_skipped: A refusal on unreasonable grounds lets the tenant go ahead or ask the court.

title.he: החליטו מה השוכר רשאי לשנות בדירה
title.en: Decide what the tenant may change in the home

what: A tenant may not make changes without the landlord's consent. Decide what you allow (hanging pictures, painting, a new fitting) and write it.
proof: the rule in the contract

law.quote: השוכר אינו רשאי לבצע שינויים במושכר, אלא אם כן קיבל את הסכמת המשכיר

if_skipped: Changes happen without agreement and the tenant may be asked to restore the home.

title.he: החליטו שמשכירים למגורים ארוכי טווח בלבד
title.en: Decide it is a long-term residential let only

what: A home let for holidays or recreation is outside the residential chapter. Decide that this home is let only for living and write it.
proof: the purpose clause in the contract

law.quote: או דירה אחרת המושכרת למטרת נופש

if_skipped: The tenant uses the home as holiday lets.
